open_points.subject: MigrationClosure identity
open_points.text: “it is a fact about the instance” contradicts “at most one per store history” and the rule that the same instance may restore a pre-import store and import again
open_points.question: Is a MigrationClosure a fact about the Registry instance or about one store history within that instance?
options: It is local to one store history; successive restored histories of one instance may each have their own closure
It is instance-wide; restoring an older store does not make another successful import a distinct closure
open_points.default_guess: It is local to one store history, as R0-89 requires.

open_points.subject: re-import after pre-import restore
open_points.text: “the owner keeps the export file and the picks, names and aliases given in the import until a checked backup holds the import” does not say whether a repeated import must use that same file and those same choices unchanged
open_points.question: After restoring a backup from before the import, must the new import reproduce the lost import exactly, or may the owner choose a different subset, display names or aliases?
options: The repeated import must use the retained export and exactly the retained picks, names and aliases
The owner may make a new import choice from the retained export
The owner may also supply a different export from the VPS
open_points.default_guess: Require the retained export and exactly the retained picks, names and aliases so disaster recovery recreates the lost state.
